summary: Comprehensive frontend i18n testing for QSO Pocket. Language selector present on all 4 auth pages (login, register, forgot, reset) and dashboard header. All 4 languages (FR/EN/DE/IT) switch correctly across login form, dashboard stats, search placeholder, band filter, Add QSO modal (all fields), Profile page, Wavelog section (inside profile), Admin panel, and Logout button. localStorage key 'qso_language' persists selected language. No hardcoded French text detected on tested screens.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1735 lines — should be split into feature modules (auth pages, dashboard, QSO modal, profile, admin, wavelog) for maintainability. Not a bug but a maintainability concern.
i18n/index.js writes to localStorage unconditionally on module load (line 18). Harmless but slightly wasteful when the value is already present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full i18n coverage verified across 4 languages. Verified strings: Login (LOGIN/CONNEXION/ANMELDUNG/ACCESSO), Dashboard stats (Callsigns/Indicatifs/Rufzeichen), search placeholder ('Nach Rufzeichen oder Name suchen...'), Add QSO modal fields (CALLSIGN/INDICATIF, FREQUENCY/FRÉQUENCE, COMMENT/COMMENTAIRE, SAVE QSO/ENREGISTRER QSO), Logout (LOGOUT/ABMELDEN), Profile (MY PROFILE, CHANGE PASSWORD, CHANGE EMAIL, WAVELOG — SYNC), Admin panel accessible. localStorage 'qso_language' persistence confirmed. Note: strings often appear ALL CAPS due to CSS uppercase — use case-insensitive checks. Wavelog section lives inside Profile page (not directly on dashboard). Profile/Admin buttons: data-testid='profile-button', 'admin-button', 'logout-button'.
